remediationSteps.title: SSH into Node
remediationSteps.description: SSH into the affected node using: ssh <node-name>

remediationSteps.title: Locate Large Directories
remediationSteps.description: Use 'du -sh /* | sort -h' to identify directories using the most disk space.

remediationSteps.title: Clean Unused Container Images
remediationSteps.description: For containerd: 'sudo crictl rmi --prune'. For Docker: 'docker system prune -af'.

remediationSteps.title: Vacuum Systemd Journal Logs
remediationSteps.description: Run 'sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=3d' to clean old logs. Adjust time as per retention policy.

remediationSteps.title: Remove Orphaned Pod Directories
remediationSteps.description: Run 'sudo du -sh /var/lib/kubelet/pods/* | sort -h'. Manually remove unused directories after verification.

remediationSteps.title: Clear Temporary Directories
remediationSteps.description: Clear space using 'sudo rm -rf /tmp/*' and 'sudo rm -rf /var/tmp/*'.

remediationSteps.title: Reboot
remediationSteps.description: Reboot the node if disk pressure persists to reclaim mounts and temp allocations.
